description: Makita B-65894 Hex Key Wrench Set, 9-Piece Metric Allen Key Set with Ball End & Standard Hex Ends, Belt Clip Holder, Heavy Duty Steel Keys for Fastening & Tight Spaces - Distributed/Packaged by Makita. Product Details: The Makita B-65894 Hex Key Wrench Set is a durable and practical 9-piece metric Allen key set designed for professional tradesmen, mechanics, technicians, and DIY users. It includes 9 commonly used metric sizes ranging from 1.5mm to 10mm, making it suitable for a wide variety of fastening, maintenance, and repair applications. Each hex key features a dual-end design with a ball end on one side for angled fastening up to 25° and easier access in confined spaces, and a standard straight hex end on the other side for maximum torque and secure engagement. This makes the set especially useful for automotive repairs, machinery maintenance, furniture assembly, and workshop tasks. Constructed from high-strength steel, these hex keys are built for durability and long-lasting performance. The included compact clip holder keeps all keys organized and allows easy portability and quick access while working.
